name: Quang
line: Opened the shop after ten years of riding the northern passes on bikes that did not fit.

name: Thu
line: Builds every bike before it leaves and does the suspension and brake work.

name: Bảo
line: Takes riders round the test loop and answers the messages that come in at night.

name: Vân
line: Calls every buyer to confirm size and delivery, and packs the bikes that travel by courier.
